sources.title: Repro - Computational Arbitrage in AI Model Markets
sources.snippet: All six major claims of 'Computational Arbitrage in AI Model Markets' (Olmedo et al., ICML 2026) reproduce on the authors' own data and code. Simple cascade-based arbitrage on SWE-bench yields up to 41% profit margins (Claim 1), growing to 55% in a six-provider market versus 46% in a two-provider market (Claim 2). sources.title: GitHub - tomonarifeehan/repromodel: Boosting the AI research efficiency
sources.snippet: ReproModel helps the AI research community to reproduce, compare, train, and test AI models faster. ReproModel toolbox revolutionizes research efficiency by providing standardized models, dataloaders, and processing procedures. It features a comprehensive suite of pre-existing experiments, a code extractor, and an LLM descriptor.
